scenarios.name: Place an order
scenarios.reason:
Added Colombia Huila to the bag and opened the bag.
Confirmed that shipping was €4.90 and the bag total was €17.90.
Went to checkout and entered Ada Lovelace’s contact and Lisbon delivery details.
Placed the order successfully; the confirmation stated that the order was in and €17.90 was charged.

analyze: €17.90 was charged.
assert: the confirmation page says the order is in and that €17.90 was charged.

scenarios.name: Free shipping from €50
scenarios.reason:
Added House Espresso and Paper Filters to the bag as requested.
Opened the bag and confirmed shipping was €4.90 with a total of €49.40.
Pressed the plus button next to Paper Filters once; shipping updated to Free and the total updated to €51.00.
Completed the requested changes and left the bag open.

scroll: Scrolling to open the bag link
click: Clicking the Bag (2) link in the top right header
analyze: the total is €49.40
assert: shipping is €4.90 and the total is €49.40
click: Clicking Add one more Paper Filters next to quantity control
analyze: the total is €51.00
assert: shipping is now Free and the total is €51.00

scenarios.name: Promo code total
scenarios.reason:
Added Ethiopia Guji to the bag twice and added one Hand Grinder.
Opened the bag and applied the lowercase promo code welcome10.
The promotion was applied successfully: the discount is −€9.10, shipping is Free, and the total is €81.90.

fix.summary: The bag stepper passed only the ±1 step to setQty instead of the line's new quantity, so + never raised a quantity above 1; the stepper now clamps the line's quantity plus the step, still never below 1.
